name: Prism ML Server
author: jaimegh-es
description: Local Prism ML model server (mirrors PrismML-Eng/Bonsai-demo). Auto-detects your GPU (CUDA / ROCm / Vulkan / CPU), downloads the llama.cpp binaries and the Bonsai / Ternary-Bonsai GGUF models (1.7B / 4B / 8B / 27B), and runs llama-server on localhost with a /health endpoint. Includes a welcome-style wizard in the terminal (sayri-prismml wizard) and a browser panel (sayri-prismml serve).

service.enabled_label: Run this server when Sayri starts

ui.sync_instructions:
Server status: sayri plugins status sayri-prismml
Start/stop:  sayri plugins start|stop sayri-prismml
Interactive: sayri-prismml wizard

settings.text: Local Prism ML model server. Changes apply the next time the server starts.

options.label: 27B
options.desc: maximum quality, needs a lot of RAM

settings.label: Quantization
settings.explain: PQ2_0 is the lightest and recommended for Ternary-Bonsai. F16 gives the best quality but is several times larger. Bonsai is 1-bit (Q1_0 only). Empty = auto per family.

options.label: Auto
options.desc: PQ2_0 for ternary, Q1_0 for bonsai

settings.label: Bind host
settings.hint: Loopback only by default. Bind elsewhere at your own risk.

settings.label: Params file (optional)
settings.hint: Custom sampler parameters (--paramsfile). Leave empty for defaults.

settings.label: GPU acceleration
settings.explain: CUDA needs the NVIDIA CUDA runtime (libcudart.so.12 / libcublas.so.12) installed. Vulkan works with just the NVIDIA/AMD driver. Auto picks the best available backend.

options.label: Auto
options.desc: detect best backend (CUDA → Vulkan → ROCm → CPU)

settings.label: GPU layers (-ngl)
settings.hint: Layers offloaded to the GPU. 99 = all; 0 = CPU only. Passed to llama-server as -ngl.

settings.label: Vulkan device index (optional)
settings.hint: GGML_VK_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Leave empty to use device 0 (usually the discrete GPU). Use `llama-server --list-devices` to enumerate.
